name: Red Squadron
intro: A veteran PvP clan known for tight squad tactics and aerial dominance.
additionalInfo: Formed in 2010, Red Squadron holds weekly scrims and mentors new pilots.

name: Night Wolves
intro: Stealth specialists who prefer night ops and objective sabotage.
additionalInfo: Tight-knit community; voice comms required for most ops.

name: Silver Serpents
intro: Competitive clan focused on ladder play and tournaments.
additionalInfo: Multiple alumni have gone on to pro teams.

name: Iron Legion
intro: A massive community clan that organizes large-scale raids and sieges.
additionalInfo: Open recruitment and seasonal events for new members.

name: Voidwalkers
intro: Explorers and speedrunners who push the limits of map traversal.
additionalInfo: Hosts biweekly community races and world-record attempts.

name: Crimson Dawn
intro: Roleplaying clan with a persistent in-game narrative and lore.
additionalInfo: Maintains an in-universe wiki and weekly roleplay sessions.

name: Obsidian Order
intro: A clandestine group focused on high-skill objective play and intel.
additionalInfo: Invite-only membership; emphasis on disciplined operations.

name: Echo Company
intro: Friendly co-op clan that welcomes casual and new players.
additionalInfo: Weekly mentor sessions and open play nights.

name: Phantom Guild
intro: Speed and precision: a small team excelling at objective control.
additionalInfo: Selective recruitment; focus on synergy and communication.

name: Dragonfall Collective
intro: Community builders who host modded servers and creative projects.
additionalInfo: Known for long-running collaborative builds and mod packs.

name: Nova Assembly
intro: Innovators and toolmakers: they focus on analytics and tooling for clans.
additionalInfo: Publishes community tools and dashboards for performance tracking.
